verdicts.title: Dynamics of Pendulum Forced by a Magnetic Excitation with Position-Dependent Phase
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This study investigates the dynamics of a magnetic pendulum under time-varying magnetic excitation with a position-dependent phase. The system exhibits complex chaotic and regular dynamics, validated through simulations and experiments. The mathematical model, based on a physical setup, includes a magnetic excitation torque with phase dependence on the dynamic variable.
